content.title: Tornado at night
content.summary: Keep a short night-time tornado warning routine on your household plan: who wakes everyone, and the safe room you all go to.

routine.title: Tornado at night
routine.ifText: If a tornado warning comes at night
routine.thenTemplate: {who} wakes everyone and we all go to {place}, and we cover our heads and necks.
